What is an inclinometer used for in landslide early warning?

An inclinometer measures the magnitude, direction, and depth of lateral ground displacement inside a borehole. It allows geotechnical engineers to locate the active shear failure plane and monitor displacement velocity to provide early warning of slope failure.

Can earthquakes be predicted by machine learning models?

No. Current scientific consensus confirms that earthquakes cannot be deterministically predicted. Machine learning in BhuRaksha is used to analyze real-time seismic catalog recordings (magnitude, depth, PGA) and evaluate their co-seismic destabilizing impact on saturated slopes, not to predict future earthquakes.
